carry_forward_constraints: S32 must not derive graph features from S31 unless each graph node/edge is tied to typed identity, edge_id/key and exact source/run/record/time provenance; node-only paths or anonymous aggregates are not creditable feature evidence.
Do not use S30/S31 clusters as ground truth while upstream ER merge decisions/cannot-link constraints remain unresolved. A wrong merge can leak into every relational feature.
Feature pipelines must use one versioned normalization/namespace policy; raw email/phone strings must not be feature-store entity keys or graph node ids.
Missing contact/identifier values remain non-evidence. Do not turn null/missing into shared-contact edges, hub counts or positive relational features.
Temporal graph features in S32 must be computed strictly as-of the feature cutoff. Edges after the cutoff and later aggregate summaries are future leakage.
If S32 uses degree/centrality/component/path features, compute them on a declared filtered graph (etype, direction, window, node kinds) and persist those filter/version parameters with each feature.
Degree in the multigraph means incident edge multiplicity; unique-neighbor count is a separate feature. Do not inherit S31's adjacency-set degree bug.
Connected-component and ego features must include/handle isolated known entities explicitly; a missing seed is not a one-node valid graph.
Any path-based feature must preserve the exact edge path or derivation lineage used; NetworkX node paths alone are insufficient for auditability.
Aggregation must be replay-safe and preserve structured detail references; duplicate source record replay must not inflate transaction-count/amount features.
Privacy masking is not authorization. S32 features and exported tables should use pseudonymous ids and least-necessary attributes; raw evidence resolution remains a separately controlled operation.
Carry real pytest gates forward for feature definitions and graph-derived feature regressions; print-only counts are diagnostics, not acceptance evidence.
Centrality, degree, component size, shared-contact count and path length remain structural features, not fraud/risk labels or culpability evidence.
Keep the inherited Level-2, S29, S30 and S31 regression debt active until those gates genuinely pass; converting defects into features does not cure them.
